# Support

CryptoBook is an open-source project maintained through GitHub.

## Before opening an issue

1. Check the main [README](../README.md) and documentation in [`docs/`](../docs/).
2. Search existing issues for the same problem or request.
3. Use the appropriate issue form so the report contains enough context to act on.

## Bug reports

Use the **Bug report** issue form and include the CryptoBook version, Windows version,
reproduction steps, and expected behavior. Attach logs or screenshots only when they are safe
to publish.

Do not post passwords, encryption keys, private document contents, recovery data, or other
sensitive information.

## Feature requests

Use the **Feature request** form. Describe the user problem first, then the proposed behavior.
This makes it easier to evaluate alternatives without tying the request to one UI design.

## Questions

Use the **Question** issue form for questions about using, building, or contributing to
CryptoBook.

## Security vulnerabilities

Do not report suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue. Follow the repository
[Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) instead.

## Response expectations

There is no guaranteed support SLA. Reports that include a reproducible case, version
information, and clear expected behavior are substantially easier to investigate.
